accounting: 10 arms x 33 charged calls, thiothixene, development screen
why_this_is_decision_relevant: A macro CAN win on this exact task: junction #3 went 0.5000 -> 0.5966 over 64 matched calls while the incumbent stayed at 0.4839. The reference-BLIND census, given the same leader and the same three operator families, beat the incumbent on 0 of 9 arms.
the_reason_my_earlier_win_is_not_a_blind: The candidates that won were selected by filtering the mined region library to >=3 rings AND an exocyclic ring alkene -- a filter I chose because I had already diagnosed thiothixene's architecture as a thioxanthene with an exocyclic 9-position alkene. That is ANSWER-KNOWN structural guidance. It establishes CAPABILITY (COMPOSE can reach a much better basin through a two-cut macro) and it does NOT establish that a blind controller finds it.

where_the_blind_pipeline_loses_it_MEASUR.reading: Lowering the support threshold fixes LIBRARY exposure (0 -> 11 offered) and does NOT fix ARM exposure: the class is 11 of 300 payloads and none of its candidates ranks top-3 by library mean within its family. Exposure at the library level is not exposure at the arm level.

a_fix_of_mine_that_measured_worse: I first attributed the miss to library-mean ranking and added a diversity filter over the payload library. Measured: plain top-300-by-mean offers 11 of the winning class, diversity-300 offers 7. The filter is left in as a knob and DEFAULTS OFF.
what_is_still_true: The operator families, the attachment-compatibility table and the continuation tournament are all unaffected -- the tournament did its job, which is to report that these particular candidates are worse than staying put. What is not established is that a blind CANDIDATE GENERATOR proposes the ones worth running.
limits: One task, one leader, 33-call rung, 9 macro arms, one seed.
